Text_Content: This happened so suddenly... You must be surprised? I was surprised too.
But don't worry! I'll take good care of you!
Here, breakfast! I specially made... huh?
...Why is the egg still in its shell?
Oh, I forgot to peel it! Haha...
It's okay, I'll peel it for you

Dialogue_ID: # Ino - Level 1 Event 3: Going Out Together

Text_Content: The weather is nice today! Shall we go to the park?
Oh, but... I fell there last time...
No, no! It'll be fine this time! Probably...?
You seem to be having a hard time lately...
I don't know much, but I think it's important to take breaks when you're tired.
Don't overdo it. I'll be by your side.
It's okay, I'll handle it alone

Dialogue_ID: # Ino - Level 2 Event 1: Investigation Schedule Worries

Text_Content: I've been busy with investigation schedules lately... I feel like I haven't spent much time with you.
I'm sorry. I should take better care of you.
But I can stay with you all day today!
Thank you for caring despite being busy
I'll try not to disturb your work
The presentation might be... but it should taste good!
Here... I made a lemon cake!
...I don't know if it's edible, but I put my heart into it!
Thank you so much! I'll cherish it
A letter came from the kingdom. They seem to be asking about your well-being.
What are your thoughts about becoming queen... these days?
I guess it's still a difficult question...
Lua... I need to tell you something...
At first, you were just a child I was asked to take care of...
But now... I can't imagine my life without you.
It's time to make your choice.
Whatever you choose... I support you.
And... I'll be with you in the future you've chosen.
Thank you, Ino. Really, thank you
